mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% eases borrowing costs, boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 4.5%, labor market tightness fuels wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX returns during low UNRATE periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising retail sales (RSAFS) and increasing housing starts (HOUST) signals broadening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during joint RSAFS/HOUST growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals impending supply chain disruptions, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 30% of instances when INDPRO < 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns during joint FEDFUNDS/CPIAUCSL growth are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth rate above 1.5% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during strong PAYEMS growth in non-recessionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% signals robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, but with diminishing returns above 4% growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 25% of instances when GDPC1 > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
